actions.label: ARDY · 企鹅步、左手挥手、站好
actions.ardy_prompt: A person walks two steps with a penguin-like gait, sways slightly, raises left arm to wave, and finally stands still in a neutral posture.
user_examples: 像企鹅一样走两步，再用左手挥手，最后站好
学企鹅走两步，然后左手摆一摆，最后站直
模仿企鹅走几步，挥左手后站好
像企鹅那样晃两步然后挥左手
请像企鹅一样走两步，挥挥左手，然后站好。
再像企鹅一样走两步，挥挥左手，然后站好。

actions.label: ARDY · 原地转三圈再鞠躬
actions.ardy_prompt: A person spins in place three times, completes the rotations, bows forward with the upper body, and then returns to a neutral standing posture with feet on the ground.
user_examples: 转三圈，弯腰鞠个躬，再站好

actions.label: ARDY · 跳跃
actions.ardy_prompt: A person bends both knees, rises onto both toes, swings both arms slightly backward, jumps straight upward once with both feet clearly leaving the floor, lands softly on both feet with bent knees, regains balance, lowers both arms, and returns to a neutral standing posture.

actions.label: ARDY · 跳舞
actions.ardy_prompt: A person performs a clearly visible dance in place, bends both knees rhythmically, takes alternating side steps, shifts body weight widely from left to right, sways the hips and torso, raises both arms outward into broad flowing arcs, briefly rises onto both toes, then lowers both arms and returns to a neutral standing posture.

actions.label: ARDY · 跑步
actions.ardy_prompt: A person jogs visibly in place, leans the torso slightly forward, alternately lifts both knees to a clear height, swings the left and right arms in opposite rhythm with broad arcs, keeps both feet near the starting point, gradually slows down, straightens the torso, lowers both arms, and returns to a neutral standing posture.

actions.label: ARDY · 你干嘛呢
actions.ardy_prompt: A person stops moving, turns the upper body and head slowly to the right, brings both hands up to chest height, lightly interlaces the fingers or plays with the fabric of the left sleeve, tilts the head slightly downward, then lifts the face to look forward with a gentle smile, and returns to a neutral standing posture.
assistant_action_examples: 她停下脚步，缓缓转身，望向你，眼神柔和而认真。 她微微低头，手指轻轻绕着袖口，带着一点羞涩的笑意

actions.label: ARDY · 待机·左右换重心
actions.ardy_prompt: A person stands naturally in place, slowly shifts body weight to the left foot, returns to center, shifts weight to the right foot, returns to center, relaxes, and finishes in a neutral standing posture.

actions.label: ARDY · 待机·轻微偏头
actions.ardy_prompt: A person stands still, gently tilts the head a little to the left with relaxed shoulders, pauses briefly, brings the head back upright, and finishes in a neutral standing posture.

actions.label: ARDY · 待机·左右看看
actions.ardy_prompt: A person stands calmly, turns the head slightly to look left, returns to center, looks slightly right, returns to center, and finishes facing forward in a neutral standing posture.

actions.label: ARDY · 待机·轻点头
actions.ardy_prompt: A person stands calmly, lowers the head into one small gentle nod, raises the head back to center, relaxes the neck and shoulders, and finishes in a neutral standing posture.

actions.label: ARDY · 待机·低头再抬起
actions.ardy_prompt: A person stands quietly, slowly lowers the head as if thinking, pauses briefly, gently raises the head to face forward again, and finishes in a neutral standing posture.

actions.label: ARDY · 待机·放松肩膀
actions.ardy_prompt: A person stands naturally, lifts both shoulders slightly, rolls them gently backward, lowers and relaxes both shoulders, lets both arms settle, and finishes in a neutral standing posture.

actions.label: ARDY · 待机·深呼吸
actions.ardy_prompt: A person stands calmly, slowly expands the chest while taking a deep breath, raises the shoulders only slightly, exhales, lets the chest and shoulders relax, and finishes in a neutral standing posture.

actions.label: ARDY · 待机·羞涩侧头
actions.ardy_prompt: A person stands in place, gently lowers and tilts the head to one side with a shy posture, draws both elbows slightly inward, pauses, then relaxes and returns to a neutral standing posture.

actions.label: ARDY · 待机·轻柔摇曳
actions.ardy_prompt: A person stands with both feet planted, makes one slow gentle sway of the torso to the left and right with very small knee bends, settles the weight evenly, and finishes in a neutral standing posture.

actions.label: ARDY · 待机·手腕放松
actions.ardy_prompt: A person stands still with arms near the sides, gently loosens both wrists and hands with one small outward and inward motion, lowers both hands, and finishes with relaxed arms in a neutral posture.

actions.label: ARDY · 对话·右手挥手
actions.ardy_prompt: A person stands in place, raises the right hand beside the shoulder, waves the forearm clearly from side to side two times, lowers the right arm smoothly, and finishes in a neutral standing posture.

actions.label: ARDY · 对话·左手挥手
actions.ardy_prompt: A person stands in place, raises the left hand beside the shoulder, waves the forearm clearly from side to side two times, lowers the left arm smoothly, and finishes in a neutral standing posture.

actions.label: ARDY · 对话·肯定点头
actions.ardy_prompt: A person stands facing forward, performs two clear but gentle nods, relaxes the head and shoulders, and finishes in a neutral standing posture.

actions.label: ARDY · 对话·轻轻摇头
actions.ardy_prompt: A person stands facing forward, gently turns the head left and right in one clear disagreement gesture, returns the head to center, and finishes in a neutral standing posture.

actions.label: ARDY · 对话·右手解释
actions.ardy_prompt: A person stands in place, raises the right forearm with the palm open, makes one calm outward explanatory gesture, draws the hand back, lowers the arm, and finishes in a neutral standing posture.

actions.label: ARDY · 对话·双手解释
actions.ardy_prompt: A person stands in place, raises both forearms with open palms, moves both hands outward in one clear explanatory gesture, brings them back, lowers both arms, and finishes in a neutral standing posture.

actions.label: ARDY · 对话·指向左侧
actions.ardy_prompt: A person stands facing forward, raises the right arm and points clearly toward the left side, holds briefly, retracts and lowers the arm, and finishes in a neutral standing posture.

actions.label: ARDY · 对话·指向右侧
actions.ardy_prompt: A person stands facing forward, raises the left arm and points clearly toward the right side, holds briefly, retracts and lowers the arm, and finishes in a neutral standing posture.

actions.label: ARDY · 对话·轻耸肩
actions.ardy_prompt: A person stands facing forward, lifts both shoulders and slightly turns both open palms outward in one small shrug, lowers the shoulders and arms, and finishes in a neutral standing posture.

actions.label: ARDY · 情绪·轻拍手两次
actions.ardy_prompt: A person stands in place, brings both hands together for two gentle claps in front of the chest, separates and lowers both hands, and finishes in a neutral standing posture.

actions.label: ARDY · 礼仪·鞠躬
actions.ardy_prompt: A person stands with both feet planted, bends the upper body forward into one clear polite bow, holds briefly, rises upright, settles balance, and finishes in a neutral standing posture.

actions.label: ARDY · 对话·托下巴思考
actions.ardy_prompt: A person stands facing forward, raises the right hand near the chin in a brief thinking gesture, slightly tilts the head, lowers the hand smoothly, and finishes in a neutral standing posture.

actions.label: ARDY · 情绪·双手轻合
actions.ardy_prompt: A person stands in place, gently brings both hands together near the chest in a shy reserved gesture, pauses briefly, separates and lowers both hands, and finishes in a neutral standing posture.

actions.label: ARDY · 情绪·小小庆祝
actions.ardy_prompt: A person stands in place, raises both forearms in a small happy celebration, makes one light upward bounce of the arms without jumping, lowers both arms, and finishes in a neutral standing posture.

actions.label: ARDY · 运动·原地走路
actions.ardy_prompt: A person walks visibly in place for four alternating steps, coordinates opposite arm swings, keeps the body near the starting point, slows down, plants both feet, and finishes in a neutral standing posture.

actions.label: ARDY · 运动·原地跑步
actions.ardy_prompt: A person jogs visibly in place with alternating knee lifts and coordinated opposite arm swings, keeps both feet near the starting point, gradually slows down, plants both feet, lowers both arms, and finishes in a neutral standing posture.

actions.label: ARDY · 运动·左右侧步
actions.ardy_prompt: A person steps once to the left and brings the feet together, steps once to the right and brings the feet together, settles weight at the center, and finishes in a neutral standing posture.

actions.label: ARDY · 运动·下蹲再站起
actions.ardy_prompt: A person stands with feet planted, bends both knees and hips into one controlled shallow squat, pauses briefly, rises smoothly to standing, regains balance, and finishes in a neutral standing posture.

actions.label: ARDY · 运动·举臂伸展
actions.ardy_prompt: A person stands with feet planted, raises both arms overhead into a gentle full-body stretch, lengthens the torso, lowers both arms smoothly to the sides, relaxes, and finishes in a neutral standing posture.

actions.label: ARDY · 姿态·左转再回正
actions.ardy_prompt: A person stands in place, rotates the torso and head moderately to the left while keeping the feet planted, looks briefly, rotates back to face forward, and finishes in a neutral standing posture.

actions.label: ARDY · 姿态·右转再回正
actions.ardy_prompt: A person stands in place, rotates the torso and head moderately to the right while keeping the feet planted, looks briefly, rotates back to face forward, and finishes in a neutral standing posture.

actions.label: ARDY · 舞蹈·左右踏步
actions.ardy_prompt: A person performs a clear step-touch dance in place, steps left and touches the right foot in, steps right and touches the left foot in, repeats the pattern with broad gentle arm arcs, slows down, lowers both arms, and finishes in a neutral standing posture.

actions.label: ARDY · 候选·自然放松站立
actions.ardy_prompt: A person stands naturally at ease with both feet planted comfortably, shoulders lowered and fully relaxed, both upper arms hanging close against the sides of the torso, elbows only slightly bent, forearms resting near the hips, and both hands kept below the waist close to the body throughout the entire motion. The person takes one slow breath and makes one very small comfortable weight shift without lifting or spreading the arms, then settles back into the same relaxed natural standing posture with arms hanging close to the body and hands below the waist.
